title: Rabbi Hoshaya the Interpreter
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 51:9, where Rabbi Tanchuma son of Rabbi Chiyya speaks in his name. Hyman reports Rashi’s explanation there that he was a meturgeman; in Yalkut, Mishlei, remez 956, the word Turgemana is absent.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Bereshit Rabbah 51:9 fully names Rabbi Tanchuma son of Rabbi Chiyya reporting Rabbi Hoshaya Turgemana. Yalkut on Proverbs 956 has abbreviated titles and Oshaya without Turgemana in the corresponding passage. Hyman’s explanation attributed to Rashi has not been independently collated here; the title and name forms remain occurrence-specific.
